structure.unit: Uniform Fiduciary Income And Principal Act

text.section:
A notice required by subdivision B 2 of § 64.2-1041 shall be sent in a manner authorized under § 64.2-707 to:
The qualified beneficiaries determined under § 64.2-701, other than the Attorney General;
Each person acting as trust director of the trust under the Uniform Directed Trust Act (§ 64.2-779.26 et seq.); and
Each person that is granted a power by the terms of the trust to appoint or remove a trustee or person described in subdivision 2, to the extent the power is exercisable when the person that exercises the power is not then serving as a trustee or person described in subdivision 2.
The representation provisions of Article 3 (§ 64.2-714 et seq.) of Chapter 7 apply to notice under this section.

A person may consent in a record at any time to action proposed under subdivision B 2 of § 64.2-1041. A notice required by subdivision B 2 of § 64.2-1041 need not be sent to a person that consents under this subsection.
